column1: # HierGen (generative, two time scales), 10/18. Li-ion MIX_large, full histories, 300-point grid in volts.
# Cycle stack (one step per cycle) + reading stack (one step per grid point, conditioned on the cycle state, predicts V
#   and dQ given I). Every run evaluates BOTH rollout modes on the same weights (the ablation): latent (cycle stack
#   feeds back its own predicted z, SOH head gives capacity) and full (reading stack generates every cycle, capacity =
#   generated Q at end of discharge; also full_head). EOL = first generated cycle with SOH <= 0.8, conditioned on
#   cycles 1..100 -> compare with the baseline AT PREFIX 100 (its 0.203 averages prefixes 1..100).
# Arms: mixer {vanilla Mamba, S4D} for both stacks x 3 seeds. Before submitting: precompute_gen_qsub.sh, test_hiergen_qsub.sh.
